messages:
natalie: Quick sync — vendor call tomorrow 10am PT with NVIDIA + AMD. Main goals: H200 availability window, MI300 driver parity, and ask Gaudi team for network perf numbers. Need a short, concrete ask list.
kevin: +1. Can we include SI test coverage gaps? Last matrix misses burst-concurrency scenarios.
raj: I'll add marketplace SKU mapping to the agenda — we need to lock launch SKUs and recommended instance sizes. cc @sylvie for pricing callouts.
sylvie: Sounds good. For SKUs let's propose two tracks: `perf-optimized` and `cost-optimized`. Will draft recommended price deltas.
natalie: Perfect. Also we should ask for early samples/dev-preview access for H200 so eng teams can validate infra changes. Proposed ask: dev-preview within 2 weeks of driver release.
kevin: For SI testing, I suggest we request the following minimal artifacts from vendors:
```
- signed driver package (sha256)
- validated AMI/OS images with tags
- kernel patch notes and required kernel versions
- perf-config for 8/16/32 batch sizes
```
raj: I'll compile that into a short checklist. Also adding a marketplace constraint: images must include runtime libs we test (cuDNN, NCCL variants) or we flag compatibility disclaimers.
vendor-liaison-bot: Meeting invite created: "Vendor Roadmap Sync — H200/MI300/Gaudi" 2024-11-03 10:00 PT — https://meet.link/abcd1234 (agenda: artifacts, sample program, marketplace SKUs, announcement cadence)
sylvie: For the announcement cadence, we need partner blackout windows and coordinated PR leads. Ask vendors for preferred embargo ranges and two candidate windows.
kevin: Also request telemetry hooks for perf regressions (simple metrics endpoint or sample harness output) so we can compare baseline. Example command for perf harness we want them to run and share results: 
```
./perf_harness --model gpt-2-xl --batch 8 --seq 2048 --gpu-profiles h200,mi300,gaudi --output csv
```
natalie: Good. Raj, can you own distributing the agenda + checklist by EOD? I'll lead the ask on dev-preview and blackout windows. If no objections I'll send the note. :thumbsup:
raj: I can do that, will post draft in #partnerships later today and tag everyone.
sylvie: No objections. Adding a short risk note about marketplace SKUs — need to confirm image signing policy for each cloud marketplace before launch.
kevin: minor ask — please include fallback plan in agenda: if H200 samples delayed, fallback to H100/mi300 config mapping and explicit perf delta table.
natalie: Noted. Thanks team — I'll assemble and send. :rocket:
